digest.component_or_area: tickets push logging (push.py, push_classify.py, push_recovery.py, push_state.py)
propositions: Expected best-effort push failures due to contention races and transient transport faults are logged at WARNING level with language that primes LLM agents to assume store corruption, causing agents to halt and investigate self-healing transient states.

Mid-retry transient transport notices and terminal contention-loss messages unnecessarily escalate ordinary concurrent-writer contention outcomes to agent-visible levels, conflating expected ephemeral failures with genuine operator-actionable outages.

Backlog count messages reference bare '..HEAD' which sessions misinterpret as code-worktree HEAD rather than tracker HEAD, causing false alarm escalation across concurrent sessions without stating the self-healing contract.

Expected contention outcomes must be demoted from WARNING/INFO to DEBUG (suppressed from agent-visible output) while preserving WARNING for genuine operator signals: policy declines, strict-mode failures, and proven-growing backlogs.
The durable push-pending marker and fsck observability remain unchanged; only the logging level and wording must be normalized to distinguish expected transient failures from real outages.
